the Little Dart Mk 26 is 75% done!
Worked on the Little Dart Mk 26 (version 11, 79% built): patched a hole in the hull (used Wren, a tiny gyroscope)

entries.why: had an idea for the wing
entries.detail: patched a hole in the hull

entries.text: Woke up fully charged in the middle of the night. Not sleepy at all.
plugged into the charging dock to sleep
entries.why: my battery meter is getting low and it is 02:55 in the morning

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "plugging in for the night!"

Sent into deep space: "This is repair unit Zeeb broadcasting from Rustwell Outpost on Kessa-9. The Little Dart Mk 26 is 70% built. If any star hoppers or deep space beacons are out there... *bweep*... read back!"
pointing brass dish at the night sky and beaming out a signal
entries.why: Gotta point my dish up and see if anyone in deep space picks up my transmission.
